NASB.1: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
NASB.2: to whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
NASB.3: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the exile of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
NASB.4: Now the word of the LORD came to me saying,
NASB.5: 'Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, And before you were born I consecrated you; I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.'
NASB.6: Then I said, 'Alas, Lord GOD! Behold, I do not know how to speak, Because I am a youth.'
NASB.7: But the LORD said to me, 'Do not say, 'I am a youth,' Because everywhere I send you, you shall go, And all that I command you, you shall speak.
NASB.8: 'Do not be afraid of them, For I am with you to deliver you,' declares the LORD.
NASB.9: Then the LORD stretched out His hand and touched my mouth, and the LORD said to me, 'Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
NASB.10: 'See, I have appointed you this day over the nations and over the kingdoms, To pluck up and to break down, To destroy and to overthrow, To build and to plant.'
NASB.11: The word of the LORD came to me saying, 'What do you see, Jeremiah?' And I said, 'I see a rod of an almond tree.'
NASB.12: Then the LORD said to me, 'You have seen well, for I am watching over My word to perform it.'
NASB.13: The word of the LORD came to me a second time saying, 'What do you see?' And I said, 'I see a boiling pot, facing away from the north.'
NASB.14: Then the LORD said to me, 'Out of the north the evil will break forth on all the inhabitants of the land.
NASB.15: 'For, behold, I am calling all the families of the kingdoms of the north,' declares the LORD; 'and they will come and they will set each one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls round about and against all the cities of Judah.
NASB.16: 'I will pronounce My judgments on them concerning all their wickedness, whereby they have forsaken Me and have offered sacrifices to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.
NASB.17: 'Now, gird up your loins and arise, and speak to them all which I command you. Do not be dismayed before them, or I will dismay you before them.
NASB.18: 'Now behold, I have made you today as a fortified city and as a pillar of iron and as walls of bronze against the whole land, to the kings of Judah, to its princes, to its priests and to the people of the land.
NASB.19: 'They will fight against you, but they will not overcome you, for I am with you to deliver you,' declares the LORD.

NKJV.1: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
NKJV.2: to whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
NKJV.3: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
NKJV.4: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
NKJV.5: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you; Before you were born I sanctified you; I ordained you a prophet to the nations.”
NKJV.6: Then said I: “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I cannot speak, for I am a youth.”
NKJV.7: But the LORD said to me: “Do not say, ‘I am a youth,’ For you shall go to all to whom I send you, And whatever I command you, you shall speak.
NKJV.8: Do not be afraid of their faces, For I am with you to deliver you,” says the LORD.
NKJV.9: Then the LORD put forth His hand and touched my mouth, and the LORD said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
NKJV.10: See, I have this day set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, To root out and to pull down, To destroy and to throw down, To build and to plant.”
NKJV.11: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” And I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
NKJV.12: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well, for I am ready to perform My word.”
NKJV.13: And the word of the LORD came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” And I said, “I see a boiling pot, and it is facing away from the north.”
NKJV.14: Then the LORD said to me: “Out of the north calamity shall break forth On all the inhabitants of the land.
NKJV.15: For behold, I am calling All the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD; “They shall come and each one set his throne At the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, Against all its walls all around, And against all the cities of Judah.
NKJV.16: I will utter My judgments Against them concerning all their wickedness, Because they have forsaken Me, Burned incense to other gods, And worshiped the works of their own hands.
NKJV.17: “Therefore prepare yourself and arise, And speak to them all that I command you.  Do not be dismayed before their faces, Lest I dismay you before them.
NKJV.18: For behold, I have made you this day  A fortified city and an iron pillar, And bronze walls against the whole land— Against the kings of Judah, Against its princes, Against its priests, And against the people of the land.
NKJV.19: They will fight against you, But they shall not prevail against you. For I am with you,” says the LORD, “to deliver you.”

ESV.1: The words of Jeremiah, the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
ESV.2: to whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
ESV.3: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, and until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
ESV.4: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ESV.5: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I consecrated you; I appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
ESV.6: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I do not know how to speak, for I am only a youth.”
ESV.7: But the LORD said to me, “Do not say, ‘I am only a youth’; for to all to whom I send you, you shall go, and whatever I command you, you shall speak.
ESV.8: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you, declares the LORD.”
ESV.9: Then the LORD put out his hand and touched my mouth. And the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
ESV.10: See, I have set you this day over nations and over kingdoms, to pluck up and to break down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
ESV.11: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” And I said, “I see an almond  branch.”
ESV.12: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well, for I am watching over my word to perform it.”
ESV.13: The word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying, “What do you see?” And I said, “I see a boiling pot, facing away from the north.”
ESV.14: Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north disaster  shall be let loose upon all the inhabitants of the land.
ESV.15: For behold, I am calling all the tribes of the kingdoms of the north, declares the LORD, and they shall come, and every one shall set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, against all its walls all around and against all the cities of Judah.
ESV.16: And I will declare my judgments against them, for all their evil in forsaking me. They have made offerings to other gods and worshiped the works of their own hands.
ESV.17: But you, dress yourself for work;  arise, and say to them everything that I command you. Do not be dismayed by them, lest I dismay you before them.
ESV.18: And I, behold, I make you this day a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the land.
ESV.19: They will fight against you, but they shall not prevail against you, for I am with you, declares the LORD, to deliver you.”

CSB17.1: The words of Jeremiah, <sup>ⓖ</sup> the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests living in Anathoth <sup>ⓗ</sup> in the territory of Benjamin.
CSB17.2: The word of the LORD came to him in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah <sup>ⓘ</sup> son of Amon, king of Judah.
CSB17.3: It also came throughout the days of Jehoiakim <sup>ⓙ</sup> son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah <sup>ⓚ</sup> son of Josiah, king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.
CSB17.4: The word of the LORD came to me:
CSB17.5:
I chose you before I formed you in the womb;
I set you apart before you were born. ⓛ
I appointed you a prophet to the nations. ⓜ
CSB17.6: But I protested, “Oh no, Lord GOD! Look, I don’t know how to speak <sup>ⓝ</sup> since I am only a youth.” <sup>ⓐ</sup>
CSB17.7:
Then the LORD said to me: Do not say, “I am only a youth,” ⓑ
for you will go to everyone I send you to
and speak whatever I tell you. ⓒ
CSB17.8:
Do not be afraid of anyone, ⓓ
for I will be with you to rescue you. ⓔ This is the LORD’s declaration.
CSB17.9: Then the LORD reached out his hand, touched my mouth, ⓕ and told me: I have now filled your mouth with my words. ⓖ
CSB17.10:
See, I have appointed you today
over nations and kingdoms
to uproot and tear down,
to destroy and demolish, ⓗ
to build and plant. ⓘ
CSB17.11: Then the word of the LORD came to me, asking, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” <sup>ⓙ</sup> I replied, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
CSB17.12: The LORD said to me, “You have seen correctly, for I watch over <sup>[1]</sup> my word to accomplish it.” <sup>ⓚ</sup>
CSB17.13: Again the word of the LORD came to me asking, “What do you see?” And I replied, “I see a boiling pot, <sup>ⓛ</sup> its lip tilted from the north to the south.”
CSB17.14: Then the LORD said to me, “Disaster will be poured out <sup>[2]</sup> from the north <sup>ⓜ</sup> on all who live in the land.
CSB17.15:
Indeed, I am about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north.” ⓝ This is the LORD’s declaration. They will come, and each king will set up his throne
at the entrance to Jerusalem’s gates.
They will attack all her surrounding walls
and all the other cities of Judah.
CSB17.16: “I will pronounce my judgments against them for all the evil they did when they abandoned me to burn incense to other gods and to worship the works of their own hands. <sup>ⓐ</sup>
CSB17.17: “Now, get ready. Stand up and tell them everything that I command you. Do not be intimidated by them <sup>ⓑ</sup> or I will cause you to cower before them.
CSB17.18: Today, I am the one who has made you a fortified city, <sup>ⓒ</sup> an iron pillar, and bronze walls <sup>ⓓ</sup> against the whole land — against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the population.
CSB17.19: They will fight against you but never prevail over you, <sup>ⓔ</sup> since I am with you to rescue you.” <sup>ⓕ</sup> This is the LORD’s declaration.

WEB.1: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
WEB.2: Yahweh’s word  came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
WEB.3: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
WEB.4: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
WEB.5: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
WEB.6: Then I said, “Ah, Lord  Yahweh! Behold,  I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
WEB.7: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
WEB.8: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.
WEB.9: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand, and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
WEB.10: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
WEB.11: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
WEB.12: Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”
WEB.13: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”
WEB.14: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
WEB.15: For, behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.
WEB.16: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.
WEB.17: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.
WEB.18: For, behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
WEB.19: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.”

AMP.1: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, [one] of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
AMP.2: to whom the word of the LORD came during the thirteenth year (627 <e>b.c</e>.) of the reign of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
AMP.3: It came [to Jeremiah] also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, [continuing] until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, [and continuing] until the exile of [the people of] Jerusalem in the fifth month (July-August, 586 b.c.).
AMP.4: Now the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
AMP.5:
"Before I formed you in the womb I knew you [and approved of you as My chosen instrument],
And before you were born I consecrated you [to Myself as My own];
I have appointed you as a prophet to the nations."
AMP.6:
Then I said, "Ah, Lord GOD!
Behold, I do not know how to speak,
For I am [only] a young man."
AMP.7:
But the LORD said to me,
"Do not say, 'I am [only] a young man,'
Because everywhere I send you, you shall go,
And whatever I command you, you shall speak.
AMP.8:
"Do not be afraid of them [or their hostile faces],
For I am with you [always] to protect you and deliver you," says the LORD.
AMP.9:
Then the LORD stretched out His hand and touched my mouth, and the LORD said to me,
"Behold (hear Me), I have put My words in your mouth.
AMP.10:
"See, I have appointed you this day over the nations and over the kingdoms,
To uproot and break down,
To destroy and to overthrow,
To build and to plant."
AMP.11: The word of the LORD came to me, saying, "Jeremiah, what do you see?" And I said, "I see the branch of an almond tree."
AMP.12: Then the LORD said to me, "You have seen well, for I am [actively] watching over My word to fulfill it."
AMP.13: The word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see a boiling pot, tilting away from the north [its mouth about to pour out on the south, on Judea]."
AMP.14: Then the LORD said to me, "Out of the north the evil [which the prophets foretold as the result of national sin] will reveal itself and spill out on all the people of the land.
AMP.15: "For, behold, I will call all the tribes of the kingdoms of the north," says the LORD; "and they will come and each one will set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its surrounding walls, and against all the cities of Judah [as My judicial act, the consequence of Judah's deliberate disobedience].
AMP.16: "I will speak My judgments against them for all the wickedness of those who have abandoned (rejected) Me, offered sacrifices or burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the [idolatrous] works of their own hands.
AMP.17: "But you [Jeremiah], gird up your loins [in preparation]! Get up and tell them all which I command you. Do not be distraught and break down at the sight of their [hostile] faces, or I will bewilder you before them and allow you to be overcome.
AMP.18: "Now behold, I have made you today like a fortified city and like an iron pillar and like bronze walls against the whole land—against the [successive] kings of Judah, against its leaders, against its priests, and against the people of the land [giving you divine strength which no hostile power can overcome].
AMP.19: "They will fight against you, but they will not [ultimately] prevail over you, for I am with you [always] to protect you and deliver you," says the LORD.

NLT.1: These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests from the town of Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
NLT.2: The LORD first gave messages to Jeremiah during the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
NLT.3: The LORD’s messages continued throughout the reign of King Jehoiakim, Josiah’s son, until the eleventh year of the reign of King Zedekiah, another of Josiah’s sons. In August of that eleventh year the people of Jerusalem were taken away as captives.
NLT.4: The LORD gave me this message:
NLT.5:
“I knew you before I formed you in your mother’s womb.
Before you were born I set you apart
and appointed you as my prophet to the nations.”
NLT.6: “O Sovereign LORD,” I said, “I can’t speak for you! I’m too young!”
NLT.7: The LORD replied, “Don’t say, ‘I’m too young,’ for you must go wherever I send you and say whatever I tell you.
NLT.8: And don’t be afraid of the people, for I will be with you and will protect you. I, the LORD, have spoken!”
NLT.9: Then the LORD reached out and touched my mouth and said, “Look, I have put my words in your mouth!
NLT.10:
Today I appoint you to stand up
against nations and kingdoms.
Some you must uproot and tear down,
destroy and overthrow.
Others you must build up
and plant.”
NLT.11: Then the LORD said to me, “Look, Jeremiah! What do you see?” And I replied, “I see a branch from an almond tree.”
NLT.12: And the LORD said, “That’s right, and it means that I am watching, and I will certainly carry out all my plans.”
NLT.13: Then the LORD spoke to me again and asked, “What do you see now?” And I replied, “I see a pot of boiling water, spilling from the north.”
NLT.14: “Yes,” the LORD said, “for terror from the north will boil out on the people of this land.
NLT.15:
Listen! I am calling the armies of the kingdoms of the north to come to Jerusalem. I, the LORD, have spoken! “They will set their thrones
at the gates of the city.
They will attack its walls
and all the other towns of Judah.
NLT.16:
I will pronounce judgment
on my people for all their evil —
for deserting me and burning incense to other gods.
Yes, they worship idols made with their own hands!
NLT.17:
“Get up and prepare for action.
Go out and tell them everything I tell you to say.
Do not be afraid of them,
or I will make you look foolish in front of them.
NLT.18:
For see, today I have made you strong
like a fortified city that cannot be captured,
like an iron pillar or a bronze wall.
You will stand against the whole land —
the kings, officials, priests, and people of Judah.
NLT.19:
They will fight you, but they will fail.
For I am with you, and I will take care of you.
I, the LORD, have spoken!”

NRSVCE.1: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
NRSVCE.2: to whom the word of the LORD came in the days of King Josiah son of Amon of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
NRSVCE.3: It came also in the days of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah of Judah, and until the end of the eleventh year of King Zedekiah son of Josiah of Judah, until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
NRSVCE.4: Now the word of the LORD came to me saying,
NRSVCE.5:
“Before I formed you in the womb I knew you,
and before you were born I consecrated you;
I appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
NRSVCE.6: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Truly I do not know how to speak, for I am only a boy.”
NRSVCE.7:
But the LORD said to me, “Do not say, ‘I am only a boy’;
for you shall go to all to whom I send you,
and you shall speak whatever I command you.
NRSVCE.8:
Do not be afraid of them,
for I am with you to deliver you,
— says the LORD.”
NRSVCE.9: Then the LORD put out his hand and touched my mouth; and the LORD said to me, “Now I have put my words in your mouth.
NRSVCE.10:
See, today I appoint you over nations and over kingdoms,
to pluck up and to pull down,
to destroy and to overthrow,
to build and to plant.”
NRSVCE.11: The word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” And I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
NRSVCE.12: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well, for I am watching over my word to perform it.”
NRSVCE.13: The word of the LORD came to me a second time, saying, “What do you see?” And I said, “I see a boiling pot, tilted away from the north.”
NRSVCE.14: Then the LORD said to me: Out of the north disaster shall break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
NRSVCE.15: For now I am calling all the tribes of the kingdoms of the north, says the LORD; and they shall come and all of them shall set their thrones at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, against all its surrounding walls and against all the cities of Judah.
NRSVCE.16: And I will utter my judgments against them, for all their wickedness in forsaking me; they have made offerings to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.
NRSVCE.17: But you, gird up your loins; stand up and tell them everything that I command you. Do not break down before them, or I will break you before them.
NRSVCE.18: And I for my part have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and a bronze wall, against the whole land — against the kings of Judah, its princes, its priests, and the people of the land.
NRSVCE.19: They will fight against you; but they shall not prevail against you, for I am with you, says the LORD, to deliver you.

NET.1: The following is a record of what Jeremiah son of Hilkiah prophesied. He was one of the priests who lived at Anathoth in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin.
NET.2: The LORD began to speak to him in the thirteenth year that Josiah son of Amon ruled over Judah.
NET.3: The LORD also spoke to him when Jehoiakim son of Josiah ruled over Judah, and he continued to speak to him until the fifth month of the eleventh year that Zedekiah son of Josiah ruled over Judah. That was when the people of Jerusalem were taken into exile.
NET.5: “Before I formed you in your mother’s womb I chose you. Before you were born I set you apart. I appointed you to be a prophet to the nations.”
NET.6: I answered, “Oh, Lord GOD, I really do not know how to speak well enough for that, for I am too young.”
NET.7: The LORD said to me, “Do not say, ‘I am too young.’ But go to whomever I send you and say whatever I tell you.
NET.8: Do not be afraid of those to whom I send you, for I will be with you to protect you,” says the LORD.
NET.9: Then the LORD reached out his hand and touched my mouth and said to me, “I will most assuredly give you the words you are to speak for me.
NET.10: Know for certain that I hereby give you the authority to announce to nations and kingdoms that they will be uprooted and torn down, destroyed and demolished, rebuilt and firmly planted.”
NET.11: Later the LORD asked me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
NET.12: Then the LORD said, “You have observed correctly. This means I am watching to make sure my threats are carried out.”
NET.13: The LORD again asked me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water; it is tipped toward us from the north.”
NET.14: Then the LORD said, “This means destruction will break out from the north on all who live in the land.
NET.15: For I will soon summon all the peoples of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD. “They will come and their kings will set up their thrones near the entrances of the gates of Jerusalem. They will attack all the walls surrounding it, and all the towns in Judah.
NET.16: In this way I will pass sentence on the people of Jerusalem and Judah because of all their wickedness. For they rejected me and offered sacrifices to other gods, worshiping what they made with their own hands.”
NET.17: “But you, Jeremiah, get yourself ready! Go and tell these people everything I instruct you to say. Do not be terrified of them, or I will give you good reason to be terrified of them.
NET.18: I, the LORD, hereby promise to make you as strong as a fortified city, an iron pillar, and a bronze wall. You will be able to stand up against all who live in the land, including the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests and all the people of the land.
NET.19: They will attack you but they will not be able to overcome you, for I will be with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.

MSG.1: The Message of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah of the family of priests who lived in Anathoth in the country of Benjamin.
MSG.2: God's Message began to come to him during the thirteenth year that Josiah son of Amos reigned over Judah.
MSG.3: It continued to come to him during the time Jehoiakim son of Josiah reigned over Judah. And it continued to come to him clear down to the fifth month of the eleventh year of the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah over Judah, the year that Jerusalem was taken into exile.
MSG.5:
"Before I shaped you in the womb,
I knew all about you.
Before you saw the light of day,
I had holy plans for you:
A prophet to the nations—
that's what I had in mind for you."
MSG.6:

I don't know anything. I'm only a boy!"
MSG.7:
God told me, "Don't say, 'I'm only a boy.'
I'll tell you where to go and you'll go there.
I'll tell you what to say and you'll say it.
MSG.8:
Don't be afraid of a soul.
I'll be right there, looking after you."
God's Decree.

MSG.12:

I'll make every word I give you come true."
MSG.13:
God's Message came again: "So what do you see now?"
I said, "I see a boiling pot, tipped down toward us."
MSG.14:
Then God told me, "Disaster will pour out of the north
on everyone living in this land.
MSG.15:
Watch for this: I'm calling all the kings out of the north."
God's Decree.
"They'll come and set up headquarters
facing Jerusalem's gates,
Facing all the city walls,
facing all the villages of Judah.
MSG.16:
I'll pronounce my judgment on the people of Judah
for walking out on me—what a terrible thing to do!—

worshiping as gods sticks they'd carved, stones they'd painted.
MSG.17:

Stand up and say your piece. Say exactly what I tell you to say.
Don't pull your punches

I'm making you as impregnable as a castle,
